thesis: A calculator is a tiny state machine wearing a keypad; the pleasure is in trustworthy arithmetic and keys that feel like hardware.
job: open it and see a display and keypad
enter digits and a decimal point
repeat equals to repeat last operation
correct a mistake (backspace, clear entry, all clear)

principles: every press gives instant visible feedback
display always shows what was just typed or computed
tricks: operator pressed twice replaces the first

principles: operators distinct from digits, equals the accent
tests: squint test: display, then accent equals

principles: state in one object, render from state
tricks: round to 12 significant digits to kill float noise
tests: click and keyboard give same result

principles: real buttons, labels, focus ring, live region, contrast 4.5+
tricks: aria-label for symbols like divide, backspace

kinds.name: immediate-execution pocket calculator
kinds.what: classic 4x5 keypad, chains left to right

descriptions: dark body, lighter digit keys, amber operator keys
after equals, digit starts new number; operator continues with result
behaviors: divide by zero -> Error, any key clears

descriptions: use true multiply and divide glyphs

anti_keywords.instead: explicit operator functions with number state
round to 12 significant digits and trim zeros
three key families with clear hierarchy and pressed feedback
full keyboard map incl. Enter, Backspace, Escape
